metadata.methods_description: Participants studied lists of 12 words drawn from 25 semantic categories, arranged so each list contained 6 pairs of same-category words from 3 categories. After a distractor arithmetic task, participants freely recalled words. Open-loop electrical stimulation was delivered to a single electrode (hippocampus or entorhinal cortex) during encoding on alternating two-word blocks in 20 of 25 lists per session, with stimulation parameters (anode/cathode, amplitude, pulse frequency, pulse width, pulse count) recorded in behavioral event files. Intracranial recordings were obtained in monopolar and bipolar configurations using Blackrock and Medtronic recording systems.
